name: Gasthof Ölberg
beschreibung:
Perched on an elevation above Innsbruck, Gasthof Oelberg combines a peaceful setting with stunning vistas of the historic rooftops and the Bergisel ski jump. Cosy rooms and classic dining promise a fine stay.

The historic Old Town, the Golden Roof, and the Nordkette cable car are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Oelberg in Innsbruck delights visitors with historic charm and panoramic views over the city.
